criteria.criterion: `--abandon "<reason>"` lets close proceed whether or not the last run ended complete; it still requires `--finding` or `--no-findings`. Status becomes abandoned, body line rewritten, snapshot/run record/summary carry abandoned; same one commit.
criteria.evidence: close.go: completeness check skipped under opt.abandon; status/statusText drive frontmatter, body line, report.Status; commit path unchanged. TestCloseAbandonStalledRun and the gate's fx-ab fixture assert these.

criteria.criterion: After an abandon, close refuses as already abandoned, brief check skips, brief list shows '-' and blocked dependents, metrics reports abandoned.
criteria.evidence: TestCloseAbandonStalledRun asserts the second-close refusal; the gate exercises check/list/metrics against the abandoned fixture and the gate passed.

criteria.criterion: `--dry-run` applies every refusal first with same messages/exit codes, then prints summary, would record/write/update/commit lines, writes nothing.
criteria.evidence: closeDryRun is called after all refusals, before defect.Add; counts findings as operator defects; prints the four would-lines. TestCloseDryRunWritesNothing checks tree clean, HEAD unchanged, no .vloop dirs.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests TestCloseAbandon… and TestCloseDryRun… in close_flags_test.go, each with a fixture where the flag applies and one where a refusal still wins.
criteria.evidence: TestCloseAbandonStalledRun / TestCloseAbandonAcceptedOnCompleteRunAndKeepsRefusals; TestCloseDryRunWritesNothing / TestCloseDryRunRefusalsStillWin, with real assertions.

criteria.criterion: README documents `--abandon` and `--dry-run` and stays under its 200-line cap.
criteria.evidence: brief close row extended in README.md; wc -l gives 192.

notes: Minor: --dry-run ignores --json and prints text; dry-run predicts defect paths by duplicating defect.Add's naming scheme, which could drift if that changes. Neither is required by the brief.
